name: cap_tantalum
display: Tantalum capacitors (chip, MnO2 and polymer-tantalum mixed)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-06 alongside cap_polymer. LCSC does not split MnO2 vs polymer-tantalum into separate buckets or attributes — the ESR value is the practical discriminator (polymer-Ta is typically tens of mΩ, MnO2 ohms). Attribute coverage here is excellent: ESR existed on 459/500 sampled parts. Packages are EIA case codes ('CASE-D-7343-31(mm)') which packages.py parses to real mm.
columns: dropped by the parser (assume 100kHz). NOTE for derating lore: tantalum
convention is to run at ≤50% of rated voltage — that judgment belongs in the
search phase (Claude should filter voltage_v >= 2x the rail), not in the data.
__comment_ripple__: key exists on ~20% of parts but values are mostly literal
'-' (skipped at merge), so expect low coverage — genuine, not an alias gap.
